study_identification_part.si4_title: Normative trajectories of R1, R2*, and magnetic susceptibility in basal ganglia on healthy ageing

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Establish normative trajectories of R1, R2*, and magnetic susceptibility (χ) in basal ganglia across adulthood at 3T using GPR; validate trajectories on an independent cohort including Parkinson's disease to assess clinical utility.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The normative trajectories are derived from the ABRIM (Advanced Brain Imaging on Ageing and Memory) dataset.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: Data utilised to derive the normative trajectories is part of the Advanced Brain Imaging on Ageing and Memory (ABRIM) data collection (Jansen et al., 2024).

rci2_hc_n.reason: After QC and exclusions, 260 healthy participants were included for statistical analysis.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: Forty-one participants were excluded ... resulting in data of 260 participants to be included in the statistical analysis (18–79 years; mean ± SD = 50.8 ± 16.8 years).

rci3_hc_age.reason: Age range and summary statistics are provided (18–79 years; mean 50.8 ± 16.8).
rci3_hc_age.supporting_text: ... included in the statistical analysis (18–79 years; mean ± standard deviation (SD) = 50.8 ± 16.8 years, see Table 1).

rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: 1. Whole-brain T1 (=1/R1) scan using MP2RAGE ... 3. Bipolar 3D multi-echo GRE ... χ maps were derived using SEPIA ... R2* maps ...

rci6_analysis_level.supporting_text: The MuSus-100 atlas was used to provide parcellation labels of the basal ganglia ... to facilitate high-quality subcortical grey matter parcellation ... spatial gradient analysis limited to putamen and caudate nucleus.

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: Key steps and software include SynthStrip, SEPIA v1.2.2.4 (ROMEO, V-SHARP, LP-CNN), MP-PCA denoising, SPM12, ANTs, BIDS-compatible T1/B1 correction scripts.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: SynthStrip was used for skull stripping ... χ maps were derived using SEPIA v1.2.2.4 ... ROMEO ... V-SHARP ... LP-CNN ... MP-PCA denoising ... SPM12 ... ANTs similarity metric ... BIDS-compatible Matlab function 'bids_T1B1correct.m'.

rci11_site_effect_handling_detail.reason: No explicit batch harmonization (e.g., ComBat/HBR) is described for ABRIM; single-site protocol minimizes site effects. PPP validation applied GLM corrections (sex/hemisphere) based on ABRIM before z-scoring.
rci11_site_effect_handling_detail.supporting_text: Data acquisition was performed at 3T (Siemens, Erlangen, Germany) ... Both R2* and χ in the PPP dataset were first corrected for the sex and hemispheric differences based on the GLM results of the ABRIM cohort, from which the z-statistics were computed using the GPR normative models.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Two-sample t-tests comparing z-scores and median qMRI values between PD and HC across ROIs with FDR correction (q=0.05). Significant increases in SNc and SNr for R2* and χ in PD.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: R1 shows inverted U-shaped ageing trajectories; R2* and χ are largely linear. PPP validation confirms elevated R2* and χ in substantia nigra in PD, supporting clinical utility of qMRI normative models.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Normative models across 11 deep grey matter structures show quadratic R1 and linear R2*/χ trajectories, with structure-specific profiles. In PPP, z-score distributions for HC align with |z| ≤ 1.96; PD shows significantly higher z-scores in SNc (adj. p=6.8e-7 for R2*, 1.5e-3 for χ) and SNr (adj. p=5.8e-3 for R2*, 0.018 for χ). Median-value comparisons also significant in these nuclei.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Registration step integrated into SEPIA to facilitate adoption; approach focuses on robust ROI-level qMRI normative modeling with supplemental spatial gradient analysis for putamen/caudate.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Narrower age-range training can overfit (less smooth trajectories); potential insufficient data to capture true variance at all ages (zig-zag 95% CI). Atlas-based parcellation can suffer partial volume/registration issues, especially for small thalamic nuclei. Single-site training limits assessment of site/scanner generalizability.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: ABRIM data and processing pipeline available via DOIs (10.34973/7q0a-vj19; 10.34973/atyn-r066). Validation cohort PPP requires separate data agreement.
